message.content:
1. Large empty/dead band above bottom nav — **PASS**: In screens 2–3, the "Book Lab Tests" banner sits just above the nav with reasonable spacing; no dead band.

2. Truncated label — **FAIL**: "Pulmonology" in Explore by Specialty wraps awkwardly as "Pulmonolog / y" — clipped mid-word (and on screen 1 it's cut off as "Pulmonolog" at the screen edge).

3. Text overlapping another element — **PASS**: No overlapping text visible; icon tiles, banners, and nav labels are cleanly separated.

4. Bottom navigation pill visible and inside screen — **PASS**: The pill is fully rendered with all four items (Home, Bookings, Health Records, Account) inside the screen bounds.

5. Content fills screen height sensibly — **FAIL**: On screen 1, a half-cut row of specialty icons peeks above the bottom nav, suggesting content isn't paginated/fitted sensibly to the viewport; screens 2–3 are fine but the initial view is awkward.

**Note for persona:** All text is English — a Hindi-reading, first-time user cannot navigate labels ("Bookings", "Health Records", "Book your token online") without assistance, which is the biggest usability risk regardless of layout.
message.reasoning_content: Screens 2/3: content ends above nav with white gap? Looks filled reasonably. "Pulmonology" truncated "Pulmonolog y" — clipped mid-word/ellipsis. Also screen 1 shows "Pulmonolog" at bottom edge cut off. Point 5: screen 1 has cut-off row of specialty icons peeking at bottom — awkward, but scrollable. Big empty band? No. Verdicts.
